The Mustangs were led by third-year head coach [[Tim Jankovich]] and played their home games at [[Moody Coliseum]] on their campus in [[University Park, Texas]] as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 15–17, 6–12 in AAC play to finish in a tie for ninth place. They defeated [[2018–19 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team|Tulsa]] in the first round of the [[2019 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2018–19 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|Mustangs]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 17–16, 6–12 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in ninth place. In the [[2018 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]] before losing to [[2017–18 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] in the quarterfinals. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
